title: 첫눈 오는 날
scene: 「첫눈 오면 만나자」던 약속. 첫눈 오는 밤, 유진은 카페 창밖으로 A 가 모르는 여자와 웃는 걸 봤다
kdrama: 첫눈 약속 · 오해(누나였다) · 손목 잡기 「가지 마」
goal: Misunderstandings, sulking and a confession, Korean-drama style

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 유진아! 첫눈 왔다. 우리 약속 기억하지?
turns.rd: yujina! cheonnun watda. uri yaksok gieokaji?
turns.en: Yujin! First snow’s here. You remember our promise, right?
turns.note: 첫눈 = the first snow — "meet on the first snow" is a classic promise

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 기억하지. 근데 너는 좀 바빠 보였는데.
turns.rd: gieokaji. geunde neoneun jom bappa boyeonneunde.
turns.en: Of course I do. But you looked pretty busy.
turns.note: 바빠 보였는데 = you looked busy, though (with an edge)

turns.speaker: A
turns.note: 바빠? 내가? = busy? me? — echoing back in surprise

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 아까 카페 앞에서 어떤 여자랑 엄청 웃고 있던데.
turns.rd: akka kape apeseo eotteon yeojarang eomcheong utgo itdeonde.
turns.en: Earlier outside the café, you were laughing a lot with some woman.
turns.note: -고 있던데 = I saw you were …-ing (reporting what I saw)

turns.speaker: A
turns.note: 설마 = no way / don't tell me

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 됐어. 설명 안 해도 돼. 나 갈게.
turns.rd: dwaesseo. seolmyeong an haedo dwae. na galge.
turns.en: Forget it. You don’t have to explain. I’m leaving.

turns.speaker: A
turns.note: 가지 마 = don't go — the wrist-grab line

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: …지금 손목 잡은 거야? 이거 드라마 찍어?
turns.rd: …jigeum sonmok jabeun geoya? igeo deurama jjigeo?
turns.en: …Did you just grab my wrist? Are we filming a drama?
turns.note: 드라마 찍어? = are you filming a drama? (teasing a cliché)

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 미안해. 근데 진짜 오해야. 그 사람 우리 누나거든.
turns.rd: mianhae. geunde jinjja ohaeya. geu saram uri nunageodeun.
turns.en: Sorry. But it’s really a misunderstanding. That was my older sister.
turns.note: 오해 = misunderstanding · 누나 = (a guy's) older sister · -거든 = you see

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 응. 이거 같이 고르느라 웃은 거야.
turns.rd: eung. igeo gachi goreuneura useun geoya.
turns.en: Yeah. We were laughing ’cause she helped me pick this.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 첫눈 오는 날 주려고 산 거야. 너 맨날 춥다고 했잖아.
turns.rd: cheonnun oneun nal juryeogo san geoya. neo maennal chupdago haetjana.
turns.en: I bought it to give you on the first snow. You always say you’re cold.
turns.note: -려고 = in order to · -잖아 = you know (shared fact)

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: …Idiot. You should’ve said so from the start.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: If I told you, it wouldn't be a drama.
turns.note: Kick: he plays the cliché back at her

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Haha, fine. …Hurry and wrap it on me. I’m cold.

review.final: 2026-11-02 Grok 2회차 재작성본 그대로 + 검사기용 최소 수정(15턴 끝 「그니까」 뺌)
